subject: sonic-xcvrd
oracle_exposure_note: Repair mode inlines the failing pytest node ids and the Validator's diagnostics into the Translator prompt, and instructs it to re-read those tests. Agents have read access to the suite. NOT a test-blind arm.
usage_note: unrecoverable; per-agent logs are overwritten per invocation and carry no usage records
protocol: analyze -> scope -> plan -> (translate <-> validate) x milestone -> parity_verify. A milestone passes only when BOTH the mocked Rust unit tests and the e2e oracle pass. A milestone that exhausts its repair budget is skipped and its failing tests deferred to skips.json; the parity loop then re-scopes untranslated source and gives deferred tests one retry.
gate: cumulative milestone selection (-k), deferred tests deselected
